title: Community Reviews Policy for Completed Stays
content:
# Reviews of a stay

**Conditions.** Reviews on reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category are left only on stays that were actually stayed.

1. A review can be submitted only on a completed stay, as the stay's status on Roamhaven's records shows.
2. A review can be submitted only within the policy's review window of calendar days after the stay's check-out date; the days are counted as whole calendar days from the check-out date to the date part of the submission, and a review on the last day stands.
3. Each side — guest and host — may submit one review per stay when the policy allows one per side; a second review by the same side is not recorded.
4. The rating is a whole number of stars from 1 to 5.
5. Reviews feed the listing quality assessment and the Superhost assessment, which read them by the time each review was posted.

## Window cases (hypothetical dates, 14-day window)

| Check-out date | Review submitted on | Calendar days after check-out | Within the window |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-07-10 | 2026-07-11 | 1 | yes |
| 2026-07-10 | 2026-07-24 | 14 (the last day) | yes, it stands |
| 2026-07-10 | 2026-07-25 | 15 | no |

## Points of judgement

- A stay that is checked in but not yet completed cannot be reviewed yet; the status must be completed.
- If the guest has already reviewed a stay, a second guest review is not recorded; the host may still submit the host's one review.
- A rating of 4 stars is valid; a rating of 4.5 or 6 is not a whole number of stars from 1 to 5.
